decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the established dumper range in which the firm has invested visibly, and two years on the market is too short to read any weakness as anything but start-up effects.
The articulated dumper rests on core engineering competence and fits the announced course of refining the existing range, so management stays committed.

The mine rescue vehicle carries higher risk because it is far from the core offer, but the heavy specialized investment, the public commitment and the long procurement cycles in this niche make slow uptake look temporary, so it is kept.
The multi-model telescopic loader line is the largest visible investment and sits at the firm's lifting core, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The material lift line is close to the core, has been the most popular lift in the rental market for many years, and has just won a large order, so it is clearly kept.

The underground loader already logged 1,000 operating hours in seven months and the firm publicizes this result, which justifies the investment despite the product's distance from the established offer.
